properties.name: light-boot.ratelimit.enabled
properties.description: Enable rate limiting. Default true, but only takes effect when both redis and aop dependencies are present.

properties.name: light-boot.ratelimit.default-time
properties.description: Default time window in seconds for rate limiting.

properties.name: light-boot.ratelimit.default-count
properties.description: Default max requests allowed within the time window.

properties.name: light-boot.ratelimit.fail-open
properties.description: Whether to allow requests when Redis is unavailable (fail-open). true (default) allows requests on Redis errors; false rejects them (security-first).

properties.name: light-boot.ratelimit.message
properties.description: Default message returned when rate limit is exceeded.
properties.defaultValue: 请求过于频繁，请稍后重试
